text.en: Find Mrs Chan at the cha chaan teng and talk to her.

text.zh_HK: 聽阿珊講唐樓，攞返單位鎖匙。
text.zh_CN: 听阿珊讲唐楼，拿回单元钥匙。
text.en: Hear Shan on the tong lau, then get the flat key from Mrs Chan.

text.zh_HK: 入樓上單位，喺木箱搵返本相簿。
text.zh_CN: 上楼进房间，在木箱里找回相簿。
text.en: Go up to the flat and find the album in the wooden box.

text.zh_HK: 帶相簿去問根叔，呢張相係邊度影嘅。
text.zh_CN: 带相簿去问根叔，这张相是在哪里拍的。
text.en: Take the album to Uncle Ken and ask where the photograph was taken.

text.zh_HK: 根叔一睇就認得：呢張相係你屋企間舖頭，未搭棚嗰陣。
text.zh_CN: 根叔一看就认得：这张相是你家的铺子，还没搭棚的时候。
text.en: Uncle Ken knows the photograph at once: your family's shop, before the scaffolding went up.

text.zh_HK: 相簿喺你手度開始發燙——條街喺等你打開佢。
text.zh_CN: 相簿在你手里开始发烫——这条街在等你打开它。
text.en: The album grows warm in your hands. The street is waiting for you to open it.

_comment: Chapter-1 arc (PLAN §12.2 quest flow): NPC-gated item via the favour chain, a condition-gated exit, an LLM-driven give with a deterministic offline fallback at every step, a secret with a reveal_if, and one item whose on_use opens what comes next. Who starts it: talking to Mrs Chan (n1); nothing needs the backend to finish.
